title: Check if All A's Appears Before All B's
approach: Check that no a appears after the first b
statement: Return true if every a in the string occurs before every b.
explanation: Once a b has appeared, any later a makes the condition false.

title: Check if Every Row and Column Contains All Numbers
statement: Return true if each row and each column of an n by n matrix contains every integer from 1 through n exactly once.
explanation: For every row and column, validate values 1..n without duplicates.

title: Minimum Cost of Buying Candies With Discount
approach: Sort prices and discount every third candy
statement: Buy all candies while every third candy in descending-price order is free. Return the minimum total cost.
explanation: Sort descending and sum prices except positions 2, 5, 8, ...

title: Minimum Sum of Four Digit Number After Splitting Digits
statement: Rearrange the four digits into two two-digit numbers with minimum possible sum.
explanation: Sort the digits; form the two numbers using the smallest digits in the tens places.

title: Count Operations to Obtain Zero
statement: Count operations of subtracting the smaller positive number from the larger until either becomes zero.
explanation: Simulate subtraction until one value is zero.

title: Count Equal and Divisible Pairs in an Array
approach: Check equal values and divisible index product
statement: Count pairs i<j for which nums[i]==nums[j] and i*j is divisible by k.
explanation: Enumerate pairs and test both the value and index-product conditions.

title: Count Integers With Even Digit Sum
approach: Count values with even digit sum
statement: Count positive integers from 1 through num whose decimal digit sum is even.
explanation: For each value, sum its decimal digits and count even sums.

title: Counting Words With a Given Prefix
statement: Count how many words start with the given prefix.
explanation: Use a prefix check on each word and count matches.

title: Cells in a Range on an Excel Sheet
statement: Return all cell names in the rectangular range from the first cell through the second, ordered by column then row.
explanation: Iterate column letters and row numbers in order, emitting each cell.

title: Find All K-Distant Indices in an Array
approach: Collect indices near any key occurrence
statement: Return all indices i for which some key index j satisfies abs(i-j)<=k, in increasing order.
explanation: Return each index if a key occurrence exists within distance k.
